metadata.description: Small Claude Code mods: status lines, bands, panes and a radio

plugins.name: backlog-band
plugins.description: Shows the active project's BACKLOG.md Now items above the prompt; /later adds to Next

plugins.name: commit-drift
plugins.description: Uncommitted files and time since last commit in the status line, with a nudge after editing turns

plugins.name: commonplace-pane
plugins.description: A docked pane of public-domain paintings (Art Institute of Chicago) whose weather follows the repo: calm when clean, stormy when it isn't

plugins.name: radio
plugins.description: Internet radio in Claude Code: /radio streams SomaFM, lo-fi and public radio through one ffplay shared by every session

plugins.name: spend-meter
plugins.description: Session cost, context fill and 5h rate-limit use in the status line
